title: Better than the deadpool...
text: But not much. The collectors boxes used to be much better from Funko. The Tee shirt is ok but I agree with another reviewer why is it blue and not black and white which would have more in keeping with the theme. They already have said the next box wont have a tee... not really sure if I am going for it I certainly cant whole heartedly recommend these "collectors" item...
label: neutral
